name: Undertone
author: Bharat / sworn.legal
description: Native binaural-beat instrument: hard-L/R beat, tanpura drone, Hindustani taals, noise colours, weather layers, breath pacer, sleep timer, interference/lava/flow visuals, fullscreen screensaver. No browser, no network. Audio via PipeWire.

barWidget.description: Play state + sleep-timer countdown. Click: show/hide panel. Middle-click: play/pause. Right-click: stop.
